podcast.title: Group Formed for PBS Debut
podcast.body: The musical group Celtic Woman was specifically conceived and assembled by a producer with the primary purpose of debuting their act on a PBS pledge drive special. This illustrates how significant the pledge drive model became as a launchpad for new artists, to the extent that groups were created solely for this platform. "The group Celtic Woman didn't even exist before their pledge drive special. They were assembled by a producer for the purpose of debuting there."
